sealed.statement: A terminal rolling-restart ACTIVE-gate snapshot preserves logging-retention queue diagnostics separately from membership-publication owner-queue diagnostics, so logging backlog cannot be reported or analyzed as owner-reconcile work and the retained seed-stall signature deterministically names the queue that actually has pending work.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Retain LogsTableService queue fields only under logging-retention diagnostics and membership-publication reconcile queue fields only under the existing membership owner-queue witness. Never combine counts, pressure flags, keys, retry state, or ownership by max, spread, or fallback when both sources are present.

Reuse LogsTableService.getStats and MembershipPublicationService.getControlPlaneOwnerQueueDepth as the two authoritative producers. Do not add a queue, recovery owner, logging owner, or alternate sampling loop.

A deterministic fixture matching the retained N=1 seed stall (logging pendingWrites=515 and pendingWriteGrowthCount=1343; membership owner pending/retrying/in-flight keys empty) must preserve both witnesses and must not select wait_owner_recovery or publication-owner backlog. The inverse fixture with a real membership owner key must continue to select owner recovery.

Older reports that expose only the historically merged logsTable record remain parseable but must be marked legacy/ambiguous or absent; they must not be silently relabelled as source-separated evidence. Preserve null and unknown honestly.

Do not change queue scheduling, logging retention, membership publication, heartbeat or lease behavior, readiness predicates, workload, protocol timers, timeout budgets, or the sealed statistical bar. This Quest restores diagnostic source identity only.

TLA+ can evaluate owner fairness after the actual stalled transition is known, while Alloy can check owner cardinality only if ownership changes. This diagnostic source-separation Quest changes neither transition semantics nor owner cardinality, so do not extend either model; run existing model contracts only if an adjacent architecture contract is edited.

claim: The June owner-queue diagnostic reused controlPlaneDiagnostics.logsTable and merged LogsTableService and membership-publication counts with Math.max. In the retained clean N=1 stall the merged record reports pendingWrites=515 and pendingWriteGrowthCount=1343 while membership owner pendingKeys, retryingKeys, and inFlightKeys are all empty; the counts are therefore logging retention pressure, not membership-owner queue depth.
rulesOut: Do not use the retained merged pendingWrites count as proof of publication-owner backlog or tune either queue from that combined witness.

claim: The diagnostic-only correction reuses LogsTableService.getStats and MembershipPublicationService.getControlPlaneOwnerQueueDepth as separate producers while retaining the old combined pressure object only as an internal input to existing priority-recovery decisions. It does not change scheduling, readiness, logging retention, or publication reconciliation.
rulesOut: Do not introduce a new queue or alter readiness semantics to obtain source-separated evidence.

claim: TLA+ and Alloy are not the discriminator for queue-source identity: no lifecycle transition, fairness assumption, or owner cardinality changes here. The source-separated witness can justify a later TLA+ owner-admission/fairness extension only if fresh evidence confirms an enqueued owner action with an empty observed owner queue and no execution.
rulesOut: Do not encode a diagnostic-field alias in TLA+ or Alloy; first use the corrected witness to identify an actual missing transition.

hypothesis: Separated logging-retention and membership-publication owner queue witnesses at the control snapshot producer, retained the historical combined pressure object only for unchanged internal priority-recovery decisions, carried both observed sources through ACTIVE-gate progress, and taught liveness analysis to distinguish legacy ambiguity from owner-admission contradiction.

the classifier trusts separated state without validating the nested owner and logging source identities

findings.summary: missing, inherited, accessor, boxed, negative, or non-finite owner pendingWrites is normalized to observed zero and can falsely trigger owner_action_enabled_queue_empty
the inherited-field test accepts separated plus fabricated owner zero but stops before classifier action, so it blesses the false repair trigger instead of preserving unknown owner depth

note: Reframe queue evidence as two independent dimensions: a source label may be valid while the depth value is unknown. Only an own finite non-negative numeric pendingWrites value may become observed depth, and only an exact observed zero may trigger owner-admission repair. This is falsified if any missing, inherited, accessor, boxed, negative, or non-finite owner depth reaches the classifier as observed zero or selects repair_owner_queue_admission.

hypothesis: Preserve hostile or missing queue-depth scalars as unknown rather than numeric zero, and extend the inherited-evidence test through liveness classification so only an own finite observed zero can trigger owner-admission repair.
